deploy_sshRequired: Automatic deployment requires SSH settings. Use --bundle-only for manual transfer when the server is unreachable.
deploy_bundleInstructions:
Bundle: {file}
Includes all images needed by selected services, including self-hosted middleware.
With SSH access, first edit deploy-target.json in the adjacent deployment directory using its _comments, then run deploy.ps1 (Windows) or deploy.sh (Linux/macOS) there. Both read this JSON; the sh entry also requires local awk.
For isolated servers, copy and extract the tar into a separate directory, then run sh apply.sh (uses the configured target directory).
Linux requires Docker/Podman, Compose, sh, tar, sha256sum, awk, curl, util-linux flock and filesystem/container permissions on a filesystem supporting flock.
Never delete or replace .deploy.lock; its lock releases after every holder exits or the server restarts. Inspect execution and recovery state after forced termination.
Partial updates require a successful full installation with matching ports/layout. Steps return nonzero on failure; result-DEPLOYMENT_ID.json records the outcome.
The bundle contains private runtime configuration; transfer it securely.
Included images:
{images}
deploy_targetHost: Required: Linux server address or SSH alias. Replace SERVER_HOST before running either upload script.
deploy_targetUsername: SSH login username; default deploy. Requires write access to directory and container runtime permissions.
deploy_targetIdentityFile: Optional private key path on the computer running the upload script. Prefer an absolute path; empty uses ssh-agent/default keys. HAI_DEPLOY_IDENTITY_FILE overrides it.
deploy_targetKnownHostsFile: Optional known_hosts path on the computer running the upload script. Prefer an absolute path; empty uses OpenSSH defaults. HAI_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE overrides it.
deploy_targetStrictHostKeyChecking: Boolean, default true: trust new host keys and reject changed keys. false disables host key checking.
deploy_targetConnectTimeoutSeconds: SSH connection timeout in seconds, integer 1-2147483647; default 10.
deploy_targetDirectory: Required absolute application directory on the Linux server; contains incoming packages, releases and successful current state. Parent-directory traversal is forbidden.
deploy_targetBundle: Required tar filename in the parent of this deployment directory. Keep the tar and this entire directory together when moving them.
deploy_bundleOnlyContainer: Compose bundle generation is supported only by docker-ssh.
deploy_selectedContainerOnly: Selected-service deployment requires a docker-ssh Compose destination.
deploy_selectionInvalid: Cannot deploy {service}: check the service name and build its image first.
deploy_imageVersionRequired: Specify an image version; latest is not allowed: {image}
deploy_bundleRuntimeRequired: Start local Podman/Docker to export middleware images, or prepare this complete offline bundle on the build machine.
deploy_configFileInvalid: Invalid YAML in {path}, line {line}. Check indentation, colons and quotes.
deploy_configFileUnreadable: Cannot read configuration file {path}. Check its path and permissions.
deploy_bundleNameInvalid: Bundle filenames may contain letters, numbers, dots, plus signs, hyphens and underscores; parent directories may contain spaces.
deploy_secretsInvalid: Middleware credentials are damaged or incomplete: {path}. Restore a backup; passwords are not regenerated because existing data may become inaccessible.
deploy_storageArtifactRequired: Storage initialization requires the application image. Select a complete artifact containing app with --artifact-dir, or run pnpm build --target docker --images app first.
deploy_localStopped: The local command process tree has been confirmed exited.
deploy_localUnknown: Local process tree termination is unconfirmed; inspect local execution state.
deploy_localNotStarted: The local command was not started.
deploy_commandTreeActive: Child processes remain active after the main command exited
deploy_remoteUnknown: Remote execution is unknown. Local SSH termination does not prove remote deployment stopped; inspect the server result and actual containers.
deploy_remoteFinished: A matching server result confirms the deployment script and recovery finished: stage {stage}, exit {code}. Verify actual service health.
deploy_transportBodyLimitInvalid: Invalid transport.maxPlaintextBytes: use an integer from 1024 to 67108864 bytes
